Hadhrat Talha (RA) Donates a Hundred Thousand Dirhams in a Single Day

Hadhrat Su'daa the wife of Hadhrat Talha (RA) reports that Hadhrat Talha (RA) gave away a hundred thousand Dirhams as Sadaqah on a single day and that he was delayed from going to the Masjid that day because she had to stitch two parts of his garment together. (Although he gave so much in Sadaqah, he did not even possess an extra garment to wear.)[^2]
The Sadaqah of Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) during the Lifetime of Rasulullaah ﷺ

The narration has already passed[^3] in which it is mentioned that Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) donated half his wealth in the path of Allaah, which amounted to four thousand Dirhams. Thereafter, he also donated forty thousand Dirhams and then forty thousand Dinaars.
The Sadaqah of Hadhrat Abu Lubaabah (RA) when Allaah Accepted his Taubah

Hadhrat Saa'ib (RA) the son of Hadhrat Abu Lubaabah (RA) reports from his father that when Allaah forgave him, he approached Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! I wish to leave the home amongst my people in which I committed the wrong and desire to give away all of my wealth as Sadaqah to Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "O Abu Lubaabah! It will suffice for you to give only a third." Hadhrat Abu Lubaabah (RA) then gave away a third of his wealth in Sadaqah.[^4]

Hadhrat Nu'maan bin Humayd (RA) says, "I went with my uncle to visit Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) in Madaa'in (where he served as governor) as he was making something with the leaves of a date palm. I heard him say "I buy the leaves for one Dirham and then sell them for three Dirhams after making something out of them. One dirham I then use to buy more leaves, one Dirham I spend on my family and the other I give in Sadaqah. I shall not stop doing this even if (Ameerul Mu'mineen) Hadhrat Umar (RA) stops me,"[^5]
